messages:
lucy: Quick thread  Post-launch smallwave triage idea  aim to reduce context switches for eng and give CS clearer expectations. Proposing 3 bins: Hotpatch, Sprint-Fix, and Tweak-Batch.

ben: 👍 Can you sketch the rubric? CS needs concrete wording for customer replies.

omar: From eng: agree on 3 bins. Important: require a 1-line dev estimate before scheduling any hotpatch. No estimate -> stays in sprint backlog.

evan: Capacity note: we can allocate ~20% of dev capacity to reactive work for next 3 sprints. If reactive >25% we trigger a roadmap freeze call.

lucy: Draft rubric below:
```
HOTPATCH (P0/P1): crash, data corruption, security -> ack in 1h, patch within 24-72h, owner: oncall
SPRINT-FIX (P2): core flow degraded but workaround exists or low-traffic impact -> triage in 1 business day, schedule next sprint, owner: squad lead
TWEAK-BATCH (P3+): UI polish, perf tuning, enhancement -> group into a 6-week batch release, owner: product grooming
DoR (intake): repro, customer impact, telemetry link, customer tier, 1-line dev-est
DoD (release): regression test, release notes blurb, rollback steps or ff toggle
```

nina: For CS: add "customer-tier" tag at intake (Tier-A, Tier-B). Tier-A gets explicit SLA and notification template. I'll update the intake template.

cs-bot: CS intake template: <https://redwood.internal/cs/intake-miniwave> (auto-posted)

omar: Hotpatch policy: if estimated >3 dev-days, escalate to Sprint-Fix unless Tier-A SLA forces exception. Also require feature-flag or alternative rollback path for any change landing in TWEAK-BATCH.

evan: Tweak-batch rollout rules: canary at 10% for 12-24h, automated smoke checks pass -> full rollout. If smoke fails, immediate rollback and postmortem. I'll add a checklist.

lucy: Quick scheduling proposal: 1) Hotpatch as needed. 2) Sprint-Fix items enter next sprint planning with 1-line estimate. 3) Tweak-Batch groomed weekly; cut release branch 3 business days before batch deploy for final QA.

ben: Can we add a tiny triage template to paste into issues? Makes consistent intake easier.

lucy: Yes, draft template:
```
- title: short summary
- repro: steps
- impact: user-visible effect + % of traffic if known
- customer-tier: A/B/C
- telemetry: link
- rough-est: 1-line (e.g., ~2 dev-days)
- suggested-bin: HOTPATCH/SPRINT-FIX/TWEAK-BATCH
```

nina: I'll make CS populate those fields and add the Tier-A contact. Also will send first replies to affected customers.

deploy-bot: Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/smallwave-postlaunch> (auto-posted)

evan: Action items: lucy -> publish one-pager playbook and tracker link; omar -> hotpatch estimate template + oncall owner mapping; nina -> update CS intake + customer notices; ben -> add capacity trigger to roadmap board.

lucy: I'll create tracker and share link here by EOD. Scheduling: quick sync Fri 09:30 to lock wording.

omar: Confirmed. I'll also add a short checklist for rolling back DB-affecting changes.

ben: Confirmed. I'll add a lane on the roadmap board for reactive capacity and set the freeze trigger.

nina: Confirmed. I'll prototype the customer message templates and ping legal if needed.

lucy: Anything blocking?

evan: Nothing blocking from eng.

nina: Nothing blocking from CS.

lucy: Great  see you Fri. Drop edge cases here.
